description: This file contains an example web page demonstrating the usage of ImgButton components from the Isomorphic SmartClient SDK. It loads various modules and skins, creates labels and image buttons with different states, and defines a function to handle click events.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: Defines label UI components for displaying static text.

classes.name: ImgButton
classes.description: Defines interactive image button components with various states such as disabled, selected, or acting as checkboxes or radio buttons.

methods.name: showClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on ImgButton components, updating the display to indicate which button was clicked.
